rules.description: A proposal must not contain unresolved jj conflicts, which jj pushes as .jjconflict-* directories.
rules.reason: This proposal contains unresolved jj conflicts: it has .jjconflict-base-* or .jjconflict-side-* directories at the root of its tree.
rules.fix: Resolve the jj conflicts, then propose again.

rules.description: Work is proposed only on a claimed lane, so everyone can see who is changing what.
rules.reason: This lane has no claim, so nobody can see who is changing these paths.
rules.fix: Claim the paths you are changing, then propose again.

rules.description: Claims name the paths a lane will change; only an admin may claim the whole repository.
rules.reason: A claim on ** covers the whole repository and would overlap every other lane.
rules.fix: Claim only the directories or files you will change, for example src/api/**.

rules.description: A change under src/api/ lands only with an approval made on this generation.
rules.reason: This proposal changes src/api/ and its approvals were all carried from earlier generations.
rules.fix: Ask an owner to review this generation.

rules.why: You own a path this proposal changes.

rules.when: (act.kind = "review" and act.body.verdict = "object") or (act.kind = "check" and act.body.ok = false)
rules.why: Someone objected to your proposal, or a required check failed.

rules.description: Blocks while any qualifying reviewer's latest verdict on this generation is an objection.
rules.reason: A qualifying reviewer's latest verdict on this generation is an objection.
rules.fix: Resolve the objection, or ask the reviewer to approve a new generation.
